name: Attack Hole
description:
Eat whatever is in your path! Move fast, absorb everything in sight, and grow BIGGER! Grab as many weapons as you can before time runs out, then blast away your final target. The bigger your hole, the more powerful you become!

Pick a cool skin, zoom through fun levels, and see if you can swallow it all before the clock hits zero!

Features:
- Exciting levels packed with stuff to gobble up
- Animated skins to make your black hole look awesome
- Crazy power-ups to help you grow even faster
- Challenge mode where you consume a whole town
- Epic battles against huge bosses
- Easy controls so anyone can play
- Simple rules and tons of fun!

Ready, set, SWALLOW! How much can you eat before time runs out?
